exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal vs. elective cesarean)
cohort: 400 children born either vaginally or by elective cesarean section.
finding: Children born by cesarean section had lower scores in locomotor, manipulative, visual, speech and language, and personal autonomy skills compared to those born vaginally.
mod_finding: Children born by cesarean section had lower scores in several developmental skills compared to those born vaginally.
